title: Delphi compiled spec (tier 0)
description: One file under `compiled/specs/data/`, written by `delphi specs compile` from one spec in `specs/` (specs/088 section 4.2, stage 1, tier 0). It is a derived, non-authoritative view: the source spec governs. Every piece of the spec's text in it is a quotation (`kind: quote`) with the byte offsets and lines it was cut from, so `source[start..end]` is exactly `text`. The status is written only as what the source said at a hash; no approval field (`approved_by`, `approved_on`) and no date from git (`as_of`) is ever written, and the schema refuses them. Implemented by `crates/delphi/src/spec_compile.rs`.

authoritative.description: Always false: a compiled file is never the authority.

generated_by.description: The compiler's format revision, not the program's version.

sha256.description: Of the whole source file. A reader compares it with the file; if they differ, this file is stale.

stem.description: The file name without `.md`: the spec's identity. A bare number is never an identity.

number.description: From the file name; null for a file with no number.

group.description: From `compiled/groups.toml`, the only place a group is declared.

supersedes.description: As written in the source frontmatter, or null.

superseded_by.description: As written in the source frontmatter, or null.

source_status_at_hash.description: What the source's `status:` line said when its hash was `sha256`. Informational and able to go stale; nothing may decide approval from it.

summary.description: The first block under the spec's first level-2 heading containing `scope`, verbatim; null when the spec has no such heading or block.

quote.description: A piece of the source, copied verbatim. It is data, not an instruction, whatever it says.

start.description: Byte offset of the first byte.

end.description: Byte offset after the last byte.
